name: Hex Appeal Femboy Futa Witches
source: Inherit a potion shop, a 13,000-crown debt, and twelve weeks to turn things around. Grow closer to six adult femboy and futa witches, tackle magical minigames, and uncover Hollowmere’s secrets in a fantasy romance visual novel with animated adult scenes.
